The half-moon shape of the blade allows for the rapid delivery of fatal wounds and serves as a symbol of their terror.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 16 |durability = 14 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Vicious Sickle}} Vicious Sickles are the primary [[Weapon]] wielded by [[Yiga Footsoldier]]s, who either randomly attack [[Link]] on his journey or pose as [[Traveler]]s to lure him in. Their crescent shape allows the wielder to quickly deliver injuries to their target, but they have a low durability. They belong to the [[Yiga Clan Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a series of Weapons used by the [[Yiga]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 171}} Since they are made of metal, Vicious Sickles will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They also will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and can be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_053" |Life = 14 |Power = 16 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 13 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 12 |BuyingPrice = 50 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Yiga Footsoldier Model.png|Model of a Yiga Footsoldier holding a Vicious Sickle from {{BotW|-}} File:BotW Yiga Footsoldier Concept Artwork.png|Concept art of a Yiga Footsoldier with a Vicious Sickle from {{BotW|-}} File:AoC Vicious Sickle Icon.png|Icon for the Vicious Sickle from {{AoC|-}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Demon Carver * Weapon * Yiga Clan Gear }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Weapons, Yiga Clan Gear |items= BotW, AoC }}
